items.review_rationale: Read the perfect closure in positive characteristic inside a fixed algebraic closure, requiring minimal perfect extension and compatible iterated pth-power roots, not arbitrary algebraic elements.

references.phrase: compatible iterated p-power roots of elements of k
references.context: Chosen roots at every p^n-power level inside the fixed algebraic closure, with pth powers relating successive roots.
Intersection/minimal field containing k and the required roots, tested by inclusion among fields in the fixed algebraic closure.

references.disposition: This construction is explicitly restricted to p>0 and does not assert nontrivial perfect closure in characteristic zero.

items.review_rationale: Read all-algebraic-extension separability and the characteristic-based equivalence, including pth powers for all elements and distinguishing perfectness from algebraic closedness.

references.context: In characteristic p>0, the multiplicative pth power mapping k→k.

references.phrase: every element is a pth power
references.context: Surjectivity of the Frobenius map on k, in the positive-characteristic equivalence.

references.disposition: This is a consequence of separability of algebraic extensions in characteristic zero, not algebraic closedness.
